issues.description: The Person.firstName field has different visibility in the template and the solution. In the template Person class the firstName field is declared private with public getter/setter, while in the solution the same field is declared public. This inconsistency in field visibility across artifacts may confuse students about the intended encapsulation and style (use of getters/setters) and could lead to inconsistent examples or accidental direct field access in solutions.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the field visibility consistent between template and solution. Prefer keeping firstName private and using the existing public getter/setter (restore 'private String firstName;' in the solution) so students follow proper encapsulation and the examples/tests consistently use accessors.
